nodes.title: README · Infinite Movie
widgets_values:
# Infinite Movie

Turns a few stills into one seamless, looping film. The LTX 2.5 engine renders one shot per transition between two images; *Assemble* evens out the motion and joins the shots into the final film.

Node pack: https://github.com/metamountain/comfyui-infinite-movie (by metamountain). Feedback and issues welcome.

## How to read this workflow
Left: this README. Top: **1 · Engine** (LTX 2.5). Below it ONE row, read left to right – each area has its help note on top:
2. **Settings** – LLM (one dropdown), size, output folder, film name.
3. **Images** – load your stills (add more: they grow downwards).
4. **Prompts** – *Prompt Style* (what the LLM is told, max words, camera) on top, then one *Auto Prompt* per transition.
5. **Director** – seconds per shot, loop, variants. Click **AUTO LAYOUT** after changes.
6. **Choose** – with variants: pick A or B per shot.
7. **Assemble + Film** – joins the shots, shows the finished film, *Open folder*.

The settings are passed along one chain: Settings → Prompt Style → Auto Prompts → Director → Assemble.
Before a render starts, Run frees the GPU (unloads the LLM); if it cannot, the render is not queued and a message says why.

Other engines: open **Infinite Movie - Engine Wan 2.2**, copy its group (Ctrl+C), paste it here (Ctrl+V) and mute the LTX group (Ctrl+M) – only ONE engine group may be active.

## Required tools
- ffmpeg (encoding/joining films): usually already there via `imageio-ffmpeg` (installed with VideoHelperSuite), otherwise https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ (Windows) or https://ffmpeg.org/download.html – put `ffmpeg` on PATH.
- VideoHelperSuite: https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

## Models – LTX 2.5 (gated: accept the license on Hugging Face first)
- diffusion_models: [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors)
- text_encoders: [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors)
- vae: [ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) · [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)
- Model page: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5

## Models – Wan 2.2 (optional engine group)
- diffusion_models: [wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors) · [wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors)
- loras (LightX2V 4-step): [high_noise](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/loras/wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_high_noise.safetensors) · [low_noise](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/loras/wan2.2_i2v_lightx2v_4steps_lora_v1_low_noise.safetensors)
- text_encoders: [umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors) · vae: [wan_2.1_vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan-2.2/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors)

## Optional
- LTX IC-LoRA pixel upscaler + https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo
- Low VRAM (12–16 GB, untested by us): community LTX-2.5 GGUF + https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

**Tested on:** RTX 24 GB, 768×960, single shots up to 60 s (1441 frames).

widgets_values_named.text:
# Infinite Movie

Turns a few stills into one seamless, looping film. An engine group (LTX 2.5 or Wan 2.2) renders the transitions, *Assemble* evens out the motion and joins the shots into the final film.

Node pack: https://github.com/metamountain/comfyui-infinite-movie (by metamountain). Feedback and issues welcome.

## How to use
1. *Infinite Movie · Settings* (far left): LLM, prompt style, GPU handoff. It is passed on from node to node (settings in → settings out).
2. Load your images; one *Infinite Movie · Auto Prompt* per transition – type a few keywords and click *Regenerate*.
3. *Infinite Movie · Director*: seconds per transition, loop, intro/outro. Click **AUTO LAYOUT** after changes.
4. Engine: keep ONE engine group active (LTX 2.5 or Wan 2.2), mute the other (Ctrl+M). Each group runs between *Infinite Movie · Engine Start (from Director)* and *Infinite Movie · Engine Result (to Director)*.
5. *Infinite Movie · Assemble* (shots in) → final film.

## How to read this workflow
The workflow is organised into numbered areas, read left to right:
1. **Images** – load your stills.
2. **Prompts (Auto Prompt)** – one node per transition; type keywords, click Regenerate.
3. **Settings** – LLM, prompt style, GPU handoff, format (far left).
4. **Director** – renders the transitions into a film.
5. **Choose** – variants builder: pick the best variant per transition.
6. **Assemble** – joins the chosen segments into the final film.
Below the main chain are two **Engine groups** (LTX 2.5 and Wan 2.2). Keep ONE active (unmute), mute the other (Ctrl+M). Each engine group runs between *Engine Start* (from Director) and *Engine Result* (to Director).

## Required tools
- ffmpeg (encoding/joining films): usually already there via `imageio-ffmpeg` (installed with VideoHelperSuite), otherwise https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ (Windows) or https://ffmpeg.org/download.html – put `ffmpeg` on PATH.
- VideoHelperSuite: https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

## Models – LTX 2.5 (gated: accept the license on Hugging Face first)

- Model page: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5

## Models – Wan 2.2 (optional engine group)

widgets_values_named.prompt: The rain eases off as a soft grey fog drifts in from the forest, obscuring the background while the house remains still. The raindrops stop early. Sound: Fading rain, soft fog drifting.

nodes.title: Help: 3 · Images
widgets_values:
## 3 · Images
Your stills; each one is a keyframe of the film.
- **Load Image** (×3: summer, fog, rain) → Director `image 1`, `image 2`, …
- Connect another Load Image to the free `image` slot: a new Auto Prompt is added automatically. Then click **AUTO LAYOUT**.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 1 · Images
Load your still images here. Each image becomes one "shot" in the film.
- **LoadImage** (×3: summer, fog, rain): pick a file from the ComfyUI upload folder; the IMAGE output goes to the Director's `image 1`–`image 4` inputs.
- Typical workflow: upload 3–5 images, one per scene/season/mood.
- Output: IMAGE → Director (image slots).

nodes.title: Help: 4 · Prompts
widgets_values:
## 4 · Prompts
- **Infinite Movie · Prompt Style** (top): what the LLM is told (system prompt), `max_words`, `camera`, `audio`, `sky_rule`. Applies to all Auto Prompts below.
- **Infinite Movie · Auto Prompt** (one per transition, summer→fog, fog→rain, rain→summer): type a few keywords in `prompt`, click **Regenerate** – the LLM writes the shot prompt from both images.
- `image_from` / `image_to`: the two images of this transition.
- Output `prompt` → Director `prompt 1 → 2`, …; `settings ▶ chain` → next node.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 2 · Prompts (Auto Prompt)
One Auto Prompt node per transition between two images.
- **Infinite Movie · Auto Prompt** (×3: summer→fog, fog→rain, rain→summer): type a few keywords in `prompt`, click **Regenerate** to let the LLM write the transition prompt.
- `image_from` / `image_to`: the two images this transition connects (wired from the Images area).
- `settings`: passed through from the Settings node (or the previous Auto Prompt in the chain).
- Output: `prompt` (STRING) → Director's `prompt 1 → 2` etc.

nodes.title: Help: 2 · Settings
widgets_values:
## 2 · Settings
One node for the whole workflow.
- **LLM dropdown** (`llm_preset`): local router/llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, custom, off. Only the fields this choice needs are shown (URL/model, API-key variable for cloud).
- `width` / `height`: 0 = engine default.
- `output_folder` (**📂 Choose folder**) and `film_name`: where the finished film goes and what it is called.
- **⚙ all settings**: GPU thresholds, negative prompt and other rarely needed fields.
- Output `settings ▶ chain` → Prompt Style.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 3 · Settings
Central settings for the whole workflow – LLM, prompt style, GPU handoff, format.
- **Infinite Movie · Settings**: set `llm_url`, `model`, `max_words`, `camera`, `audio`, `width`/`height`, `negative`, GPU thresholds.
- The `settings ▶ chain` output is passed node-to-node (Auto Prompt → Auto Prompt → … → Director → Assemble).
- Only ONE Settings node is needed; its output fans out to all consumers.

nodes.title: Help: 5 · Director
widgets_values:
## 5 · Director
Turns images + prompts into shots.
- Sockets: `settings`, `engine` (empty = the one active engine group), `image …`, `prompt …`.
- `seconds` per shot, `loop` (last image → first), `mode` (segments / one pass), `variants` (2 = render A and B, then choose).
- Output `shots ▶ Assemble` (top) → Choose / Assemble.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 4 · Director
The core render node – turns images + prompts into a film.
- **Infinite Movie · Director**: set `seconds` (per-transition length), `loop` (seamless loop), `mode` (segments / one pass), `variants` (1 = single pass, 2 = variants builder).
- `image 1`–`image 5`: from the Images area.
- `prompt 1 → 2` …: from the Auto Prompt nodes.
- `settings`: from the Settings chain.
- Output: `shots ▶ Assemble` (SHOTS pipe) → Choose.

nodes.title: Help: 6 · Choose
widgets_values:
## 6 · Choose
Only matters with `variants` = 2: shows variant A and B of each shot side by side.
- The better one is pre-selected (cut / flicker / particles / jerk check); click A or B to override.
- Status line: waiting / rendering / choose / assemble. **ASSEMBLE** appears when a choice changed.
- Output `shots` → Assemble.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 5 · Choose
Variants builder (Auftrag 61): for each transition, shows variant A and B side by side.
- **Infinite Movie · Choose**: an algorithm pre-selects the better variant (CUT/FLICKER/PARTICLES + jerk metric); you can override per transition in the frontend.
- `shots` input: the SHOTS pipe from the Director.
- `choices` (hidden): written by the frontend, e.g. `'auto,b,auto'`.
- Output: `shots` (SHOTS, chosen segments) → Assemble; `segments` (STRING, one per line).

nodes.title: Help: 7 · Assemble + Film
widgets_values:
## 7 · Assemble + Film
- **Infinite Movie · Assemble**: joins the shots, evens out the motion (`retime`), optional crossfade (`strength`), target length (`seconds_out`), RIFE (`interpolate`). Folder and name come from Settings.
- **Infinite Movie · Film**: plays the finished film, confirms where it was saved, **📂 Open folder**.

widgets_values_named.text:
## 6 · Assemble
Joins the chosen segments into the final film.
- **Infinite Movie · Assemble**: `strength` (crossfade), `seconds_out` (output length), `retime` (speed-normalise), `loop` (seamless loop), `fps`, `interpolate` (RIFE), `copy_to` (output folder).
- `shots` input: the SHOTS pipe from Choose (highest priority; overrides `segments`/`save_folder`/`save_name`).
- `settings`: from the Settings chain.
- Output: `video` (VIDEO), `video_path` (STRING), `images` (IMAGE).

nodes.title: Help: 1 · Engine: LTX 2.5
widgets_values:
## 1 · Engine: LTX 2.5
Renders one shot (start image → end image) per call from the Director. Lightricks LTX 2.5, 22B distilled, int8.
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Start** (from Director): `start_image`, `end_image`, `prompt`, `negative`, `seed`, `width`, `height`, `length`.
- **UNETLoader / VAELoader / CLIPLoader**: LTX 2.5 model, video VAE, audio VAE, Gemma-4 text encoder.
- **LTXVPreprocess** (×2): prepares the start/end images.
- **LTXVConditioning + LTXVAddGuide** (×2): conditioning with first/last-frame guides.
- **SamplerCustomAdvanced + LTXVDualCFGGuider**: 8 steps, manual sigmas.
- **VAEDecodeTiled**: latent → frames (tiled, saves VRAM).
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Result** (to Director): the rendered frames.
- Only ONE engine group may be active; mute any other (Ctrl+M).

widgets_values_named.text:
## ENGINE: LTX 2.5
Video generation engine (Lightricks LTX 2.5, 22B distilled, int8).
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Start** (from Director): receives `start_image`, `end_image`, `prompt`, `negative`, `seed`, `width`, `height`, `length`.
- **UNETLoader / VAELoader / CLIPLoader**: load the LTX 2.5 model, video VAE, audio VAE, and Gemma-4 text encoder.
- **LTXVPreprocess** (×2): prepares start/end images for the model.
- **LTXVConditioning + LTXVAddGuide** (×2): builds positive/negative conditioning with first/last-frame guides.
- **SamplerCustomAdvanced + LTXVDualCFGGuider**: runs the diffusion sampling (8 steps, manual sigmas).
- **VAEDecodeTiled**: decodes the latent to pixels (tiled to save VRAM).
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Result** (to Director): outputs the rendered frames.
- Keep ONE engine group active; mute the other (Ctrl+M).

widgets_values: Describe the transition from image 1 to image 2 in ONE sentence, max {words} words.

widgets_values_named.prompt: The rain eases off as a soft grey fog drifts in from the forest, obscuring the background while the house remains still. The raindrops stop early. Sound: Fading rain, soft fog drifting.

nodes.title: Help: 8 · Upscale
widgets_values:
## 8 · Upscale (optional)
- Off by default. **Select the group, Ctrl+M** turns it on.
- Then **ASSEMBLE** also renders an upscaled film: model upscale (Upscale Crop Universal) + **LTX Refine** 1:1 (prompt `photographic, 4k`), with the film's sound.
- The second **Film** node shows the upscaled version.
